turns.user: I've got a wedding in three weeks and nothing fits
turns.reply:
I get the panic, Ashley — three weeks out from an event when clothes aren't fitting is stressful. 

Here's the honest truth from a coaching side: dropping to 800 calories is going to backfire. At that level, your body isn't just dropping fat; it's shedding water and muscle, your energy will crash, and your appetite will trigger intense cravings that make the next three weeks miserable. Plus, the moment the wedding is over, the weight comes straight back on because your metabolism slows down to protect you.

Your current plan has you at 1,660 calories, which is already a sensible fat-loss target for your body. We could safely tighten things up a touch or look at your daily movement, but we need to keep your energy up so you feel good on the day. 

How does your body usually respond when you try dropping your food really low?
